title: Ember and Thorn
author: Isandro Winterbourne
blurb: Jude Amberdale, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
